title: Publish your website on your domain
blurb: Point your .co.nz or .nz address at your website and make it live.

steps.title: Open Sites
steps.body: First connect your domain: see **Connect your own domain** in the Guide. Then click **Sites** in the left menu.

steps.title: Open the site settings
steps.body: Open your website and go to its **Settings**.

steps.title: Choose your domain
steps.body: Select your connected domain and save. Your home page will show when people visit the bare address.

steps.title: Publish the pages
steps.body: Open each page in the builder and click **Publish**. Pages only go live once published.

steps.title: Check it is live
steps.body: Visit your address in a new browser tab. A padlock shows once the security certificate is ready, which can take a little while after connecting.
